messages:
priya: Noticed a pattern: several fncall requests where console shows fallback path but no schema reject in the traces. Looks like validator isn't surfacing a reason and gateway is treating it as success.
sam: Can you paste an example payload from the edge logs?
priya: snippet from edge proxy (anonymized):
```
{"req_id":"req-84f","model":"open-7b","result":{"text":"...","tool_call":null},"validator":null}
```
no `validator` envelope at all.
maria: That explains support tickets where customers see "no tool run" and we can't say why. Console only surfaces rejects if `validator.error` exists.
kevin: Historically we nulled `validator` to avoid charging customers for soft failures. But it's destroying observability.
priya: Proposal: keep the billing semantics but always emit a minimal `validator` object: `{status: "soft_reject", code: "enum_mismatch", billing_exempt: true}`. That preserves charge logic but gives telemetry.
sam: 👍 Also suggest metric name `fncall.validation.soft_rejects_total` with labels {env,route,model}. Current `fncall.rejects` is too coarse.
ui-team: Console changes: add a per-route "soft rejects" column (collapsed by default) and a timeline card. We'll link to request id for quick jump. Avoid spamming top-level charts.
maria: Need to update routing: gateway currently treats `validator==null` as success and routes to fallback. That skews quota and SLA reporting. We should treat `status==soft_reject` as a separate route tag `route=soft_reject`.
kevin: I'll change router logic: if `validator && validator.status==\"soft_reject\"` set route key to `soft_reject`. Backward compat: if `validator` missing, fall back to previous behavior.
sam: Tests? Add unit tests for router and an integration test that verifies metric increments and audit log emission. I can own test work.
priya: Audit logs: emit `AUDIT fncall soft_reject req-84f reason=enum_mismatch` so logging pipeline can extract reason. Regex suggestion: `AUDIT fncall soft_reject (r|req)-[0-9a-z]+ reason=[a-z_]+`.
ui-team: We'll add small UX text explaining "soft rejects" vs "hard rejects" for support and customers. Also add a toggle in the per-route table for showing raw request ids.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging rollout started for proxy change (deploy id s-402) by kevin 5:22UTC 5 checks running.
kevin: pushing metrics and audit forwarder to staging now. Sam, ping me when tests are green and i'll run canary.
sam: tests added: router soft_reject path + metric label assertions. Running locally, passing. Will run CI next.
maria: After deploy and canary, we'll update docs and a short changelog for support. Also consider adding a sampled debug dump in console for a short period to help triage.
priya: timeline: aim to merge router + validator envelope in 48h, metrics + audit in same window, console patch behind feature flag for gradual rollout. No objections?
ui-team: No objections. Will prepare feature-flagged UI PR.
kevin: opening PRs now. tagging @sam @maria.
priya: thanks all. Follow up here with staging canary results. :thumbsup:
